chunks: "On the night of the twenty-fifth of Dhū al-Qaʿdah, the earth was spread out from beneath the Kaʿbah. So whoever fasts on that day is like one who has fasted for sixty months."

key_terms.الْكَعْبَةِ: the Kaʿbah, the sacred House in Makkah
key_terms.ذِي الْقَعْدَةِ: the month of Dhū al-Qaʿdah in the Islamic calendar
key_terms.سِتِّينَ شَهْراً: sixty months, describing the magnitude of reward
key_terms.لَيْلَةُ: the night of a designated sacred date

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of fasting on the twenty-fifth of Dhū al-Qaʿdah?
ai.summary: Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام states the special significance of the twenty-fifth of Dhū al-Qaʿdah, linking it to the spreading out of the earth from beneath the Kaʿbah. The hadith also highlights the great reward of fasting on that day, equating it with fasting for sixty months.
